thread:
lauren: heads-up: noticed a small but systematic invoice delta for tenant 'atlas' vs preview. Its tiny (~0.03%) but persistent over last month. Looks like rounding behaviour changed with the new streaming-metering patch.

marco: concrete numbers?

lauren: preview shows total_tokens=1,235,678 but ledger final is 1,235,671. Checked other tenants, similar tiny deltas but concentrated on high-volume ones.

yana: interesting. we switched preview to round each request to nearest integer after token-estimation (to show cleaner numbers in console). Ledger pipeline sums raw fractional token estimates and only rounds at invoice time (bankers rounding). That mismatch will create N small per-request residuals.

peter: oh right. preview was changed for UI ergonomics. IIRC the streaming-metering change (PR #4110) added per-chunk estimate and rounded per-chunk for fast counters.

lauren: sample event from preview stream (copied raw):
```
{
  "req_id": "req_9090",
  "tenant": "atlas",
  "tokens_estimate": 12.6,
  "preview_tokens": 13,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-14T09:12:21Z"
}
```

yana: ledger raw ingest keeps tokens_estimate as float and applies per-invoice rounding: invoice_total = round(sum(tokens_estimate), 0, ROUND_HALF_EVEN). So sum(12.6) contributes 12.6 until invoice aggregation. Preview contributing 13 per event will bias upward.

marco: but in practice your preview was lower than ledger? lauren reported preview > ledger by 7 tokens less (preview higher). wait recap: lauren said preview 1,235,678 vs ledger 1,235,671 -> preview is higher by 7. makes sense with per-request rounding up.

lauren: yes. the pattern correlates with high-rate tenants where many small fractional estimates round up more often. Random rounding error should cancel but bias exists because preview used round-to-nearest-away-from-zero while ledger uses banker's rounding.

peter: so two differences: (A) rounding frequency (per-request vs per-invoice) and (B) rounding mode. We need a canonical policy.

ops-bot: suggestion: add metric meter.rounding_mode_mismatch_count and meter.rounding_residual_sum to emit daily residuals per-tenant.

yana: proposal: change preview to show canonical cumulative tokens computed by accumulating fractional estimates in a lightweight sliding-window accumulator per-tenant (carry-forward remainder). That will make preview match ledger within one invoice rounding.

marco: migrating preview to accumulate fractions cheaply is feasible. We already have per-tenant counters for sampling. But theres UX risk: preview will show non-integer tokens (e.g., 12.6) unless we format. We can keep display integer by showing rounded invoice-style value but compute using same ledger-sum semantics.

lauren: I prefer compute semantics match ledger exactly. Display can be formatted. Also we should reconcile historical previews for affected tenants (last 30 days) and emit a reconciliation report and optionally corrected preview snapshots for the console.

peter: owners: @marco implement preview accumulator and switch rounding to banker's rounding at display time; @yana add metrics and an hourly job that computes residuals per-tenant and alerts if residual_sum > 50 tokens/day for any tenant; @lauren run a backfill to recompute preview totals for last 30d for top 50 tenants and produce reconciliation report.

marco: I'll open PR (preview-metering#478) that replaces per-request rounding with per-tenant fractional accumulator with 60s flush. Will canary to preview cluster.

yana: adding metrics: meter.rounding_residual_sum (gauge per-tenant), meter.rounding_mismatch_ratio (histogram). Alert when mismatch_ratio > 0.0005 for 1h for large tenants.

billing-bot: FYI: customers are billed from ledger; no invoices will be changed. If reconciliation emits corrected previews we should prefix them in console UI with "reconciled" to avoid confusion.

lauren: good note. we'll prepare an internal support blurb explaining previews were approximated for UX and were aligning them with billing semantics.

ops-bot: deploy-canary: preview-metering v4.10 -> v4.11 triggered by marco at 6820011134

marco: canary looks good so far (canary preview cluster p95 residual ~0.3 tokens over 10m). If numbers stay low I'll promote in 45m.

lauren: I'll start the backfill for top 50 tenants now. Will post reconciliation diff when done.

peter: thanks. Quick follow-up: update console changelog describing that preview now matches ledger aggregation semantics and that small historical corrections may appear. Also mention formatting change for display if any.

lauren: will do. closing loop once backfill report posted. :thumbsup:
